# Dayo Adetiloye

> A comprehensive youth entrepreneurship and business consulting platform offering tailored startup guides, business plans, and SME development services for Nigerian entrepreneurs.

Dayo Adetiloye's website serves as a hub for aspiring entrepreneurs in Nigeria, providing practical business planning resources, consulting services, and ready-made business plan templates across various industries including agriculture, food production, and services. The platform combines expert business coaching with accessible digital tools to support youth empowerment and small business growth.

## Business Plan Templates & Resources

- [Dayo Adetiloye Shop – Get enriched.](https://dayoadetiloye.com/shop): E-commerce shop selling business plans for various Nigerian startup ventures
- [Textile Colouring & Dye Business Plan](https://dayoadetiloye.com/shop/product/textile-colouring-dye-business-plan): Textile and dye production business plan template for Nigerian entrepreneurs
- [Patilad Bakery Business Plan](https://dayoadetiloye.com/shop/product/patilad-bakery-business-plan): PATILAD bakery and confectionery business plan with market and financial analysis
- [Catering Business Plan](https://dayoadetiloye.com/shop/product/catering-business-plan): Event catering business startup guide and planning template for Nigeria
- [Catfish Production and Processing Business Plan](https://dayoadetiloye.com/shop/product/catfish-production-2): Aquaculture and catfish farming business plan for Nigerian agribusiness startups
